depictions.name: Fountain of Glauke
depictions.text: The Fountain of Glauke was a fountain located in Korinth in Korinthia, Greece. Named after Jason's second wife, Glauke, the fountain was where she was said to have thrown herself after Jason's first wife, Medea, gave Glauke a poisoned cape. During the Peloponnesian War the misthios Kassandra visited the place.
